description: Android activity class implementing immersive full-screen mode with UI visibility toggling and gesture detection.

classes.name: ImmersiveActivity
classes.description: Main activity managing immersive UI mode with gesture controls and system UI visibility handling.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up UI controls, gesture detection, and immersive mode.

methods.name: onWindowFocusChanged
methods.description: Handles focus changes to toggle immersive UI mode appropriately.

methods.name: hideSystemUI
methods.description: Hides system UI elements to enable immersive full-screen mode.

methods.name: showSystemUI
methods.description: Shows system UI elements, exiting immersive mode.

methods.name: delayedHide
methods.description: Schedules hiding of system UI after a specified delay.
